title.narrative: SCADA coverage transmission

description.narrative:
Level Output of So far, 22 substations have been fully connected to the system. Of the 4 substations remaining, Lilongwe C, Bwengu and Karonga have been partially connected to the system, whereas Kang'oma has not been connected to the system. It is expected that full connection of the remaining substations will be completed post-compact.
% Complete to date is calculated by taking the (Actual-Baseline/Target-Baseline)*100, which is what gives us the 47.3% Complete to date. As stated above, MCC connected 22 substations, with only 4 remaining to be connected.
